rationale: The application requires a professional, structural 'infrastructure-over-aesthetic' vibe similar to emergent.sh. We prioritize clarity, minimal friction, crisp typography, and a sharp dark neutral palette with subtle violet/blue accents to highlight actions without overwhelming the video content.

colors.css_variables_instructions: Implement these as CSS variables in global styles (e.g. :root { --background: 10 10 11; --primary: 90 103 216; } using HSL or RGB) to seamlessly integrate with Tailwind and Shadcn.

imports: /* Assume Geist is either imported via next/font or standard CDN; fallback to Inter if purely unavailable, but try Geist first. */

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High white space (negative space), clean grid alignment, clear visual hierarchy. Avoid centered Bootstrap-style cards; use sharp, asymmetrical layouts.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Use a Bento-grid style for 'My Active Reviews' with sharp corners (rounded-md or rounded-none) and subtle 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.workspace_desktop: Two-panel structural layout. Left: 16:9 Video Player (max-height 80vh) + floating bottom dock for tools. Right: 300-350px fixed width sidebar for Threaded Comments and P2P Avatars.
spacing_and_layout.workspace_mobile: Video pinned to top. Drawing toolbar as a horizontal scrolling dock or FAB at the bottom. Comments inside a swipeable bottom-sheet drawer (Instagram style).
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Keep border radii minimal. Use `rounded-md` (6px) or `rounded-sm` (4px). Avoid overly pill-shaped buttons unless it's the floating FAB.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges, 1px border. Primary CTA uses #5A67D8. Avoid excessive drop shadows; rely on color contrast and 1px inner glows if needed.
components.video_player: Must maintain strict 16:9 aspect ratio. The HTML5 Canvas overlay MUST be absolute positioned, top-0 left-0, w-full h-full, pointer-events-auto when drawing, transparent background.
components.toolbar: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface_glass border border-border`). Contains vector tools (arrow, circle, dashed line, freehand, stamps) and color picker.
components.comments: Threaded Instagram-style. Avatars (rounded-full), User Handle (font-medium), Timestamp/Video Timecode (font-mono text-primary), nested replies indented with a subtle left border.
components.p2p_panel: Row of avatars in the sidebar. Online status indicated by a crisp 2px solid ring around the avatar (Success: #10B981, Offline: #5C5C66).
components.ad_modal: Focus-Lock rewarded ad full-screen modal. Must blur the background (`backdrop-blur-2xl`) and center a sharp countdown timer in JetBrains Mono.
components.shadcn_overrides: Do NOT use default Shadcn heavy rounding. Override `--radius` to `0.3rem` or `0rem` in Tailwind config. Use pure black/dark grey for dialog overlays.

motion_and_interactions.general: Minimalist. 'Infrastructure over aesthetic'. Avoid bouncy springs. Use snappy ease-out transitions (150-200ms).
motion_and_interactions.watermark: Dynamic floating watermark must drift slowly across the video player using CSS translate/keyframes, 30-40% opacity, pointer-events-none.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Background slightly lightens (e.g., from surface to border color). Explicitly change text colors on hover to ensure contrast.
motion_and_interactions.drawer_mobile: Use standard bottom sheet drag physics (if using Framer Motion, use a firm spring: stiffness 300, damping 30).

icons.style: Crisp, 1.5px stroke width. Consistent sizing (usually w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5).

testing.data_testid_rules: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, video controls, canvas tools, comment replies, pricing cards) MUST include a kebab-case `data-testid` attribute describing its role (e.g., `data-testid="play-video-button"`, `data-testid="tool-draw-circle"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize building the structural layout first: The 16:9 video player with absolute-positioned transparent canvas is the critical engineering task.
Implement the 'emergent.sh' aesthetic faithfully: dark, extremely clean, minimal radiuses, using #5A67D8 as the single accent color. DO NOT inject purple gradients.
For the toolbar, use an absolute or fixed floating dock with backdrop-blur. For mobile, stick it to the bottom.
Ensure all fonts fall back gracefully if Geist is not loaded, but try to use standard sans stack tuned to look crisp.
P2P Avatar rings and Watermark animations must rely on Tailwind utility classes or custom CSS keyframes, not heavy JS.
Ad modal must pause background processes and intercept clicks until the 15s timer completes.
Use Shadcn UI but heavily strip out the 'default Vercel look' by applying our sharp borders, dark backgrounds, and flat interactions.
All .js components should be functional React components. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx). Use prop-types if necessary, but keep it modern ES6+ React.
